definitions.explanation: the first year of something such as an era, a policy, a system, or a person's time in a position

examples.japanese: {初年|しょねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だった。
examples.english: Sales in the first year were strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧{初年|しょねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There was a lot of confusion in the first year of the system's introduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初年|しょねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基礎科目|きそかもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学|まな}び→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧、{二年目|にねんめ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: At this university, students focus on foundational subjects in the first year and enter their specialty from the second year.

notes:
A formal term for the first year of a period, often used in business, academic, and governmental contexts. Frequently appears in compound forms and is common in news and official reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{初年度|しょねんど}→初年度：25268_shonendo⟧: first fiscal year (the most common compound form)
- {初年|しょねん}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: first-year effect
- ⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧{初年|しょねん}: first year of introduction
- ⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧{初年|しょねん}: first year of business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一年目|いちねんめ}: first year — the general, everyday way to say "first year"
- ⟦{元年|がんねん}→元年：11658_gannen⟧: first year of an era — specifically the first year of a Japanese imperial era or a symbolic new beginning
- ⟦{初年度|しょねんど}→初年度：25268_shonendo⟧: first fiscal year — the compound form, most commonly used in business and government
